display.purpose: Home hero name only; uppercase, gilded.

headline.purpose: In-page section title cards; uppercase, gilded.

title.purpose: Project titles (uppercase, gilded); publication titles in mixed case at 1.6rem to 2.2rem.

lead.purpose: Italic subtitles under title cards, in weathered bone.

body.purpose: Base prose at weight 300 in bone.

label.purpose: All small labels: uppercase Cinzel 600 at 0.24em, lining numerals; 0.6rem to 0.72rem.

button.purpose: shadcn button text; 0.75rem to 1rem by size.

shadows.name: gilded-light
shadows.purpose: Every gold title: a cut edge and a warm firelight glow, as a filter because a text-shadow paints over clipped gilt.

shadows.name: double-gold-frame
shadows.value: inset 0 0 0 1px hsl(var(--gold-dim)), inset 0 0 0 5px hsl(var(--void)), inset 0 0 0 6px hsl(var(--gold-dim) / 0.5)
shadows.purpose: Framed panels, project etchings, portrait and resume frames.

shadows.name: gold-hairline
shadows.purpose: Outline buttons, link actions, roundels at rest; hover swaps to hsl(var(--gold)).

shadows.name: object-shadow
shadows.purpose: The SVG Ring as a physical object.

motion.name: ease-prologue
motion.purpose: All entrances, the Ring's fall, the inscription sweep, the mobile menu curtain.

motion.name: rise-from-black
motion.value: opacity 0 to 1, translateY 14-18px to 0, blur 8px to 0 over 1.1-1.4s
motion.purpose: Title cards and hero copy entering; staggered 1.9s, 2.25s, 2.55s on home.

motion.name: ring-fall
motion.value: translateY -140px and scale 0.55 to rest over 1.6s; inscription ignites at 1.5s

motion.name: etching-rise
motion.value: opacity 0 to 1, translateY 10px to 0 over 1600ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)
motion.purpose: Project etching line work rising out of black once a quarter of the article is in view.

motion.name: etching-catch
motion.value: scale 0.05 to 1 from the root over 1100ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 250ms; pools 1400ms, embers 900ms, smoke 2400ms ease-out; per-element delay --d
motion.purpose: Each fire in a plate catching in turn on a per-scene stagger.

motion.name: etching-flare
motion.value: flames scale 1.25 over 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); pools 0.7 to 1 over 600ms
motion.purpose: While the visitor hovers or focuses within a project article.

motion.name: etching-loops
motion.value: flicker 1.3-2.2s alternate per tongue (scale and skew), sparks 3.2s, smoke sway 7s alternate, smoulder 2.8s alternate; paused off screen
motion.purpose: Living fire while a plate is on screen.

motion.name: smoke-drift
motion.value: 26s and 38s ease-in-out infinite, translate3d ±3% and scale 1.08
motion.purpose: Two smoke layers behind every page.

motion.name: state
motion.value: 200ms ease-out (buttons), 300ms (nav colour, underline width, bar fill)

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all animation and transition durations collapse to 0.001ms; etching transition delays zeroed so plates arrive whole; content starts lit and ignited

components.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@600&family=Spectral:ital,wght@0,300;1,300&display=swap');:host{--void:30 20% 2%;--gold:42 54% 54%;--gold-bright:44 81% 71%;--gold-dim:42 44% 34%;--gilt-pale:47 92% 88%;--fire:19 74% 52%;--fire-deep:11 79% 27%;--fire-core:34 100% 72%;--fire-white:42 100% 87%;}.ds-etch{display:block;position:relative;max-width:560px;padding:12px;background:hsl(var(--void));box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px hsl(var(--gold-dim)),inset 0 0 0 5px hsl(var(--void)),inset 0 0 0 6px hsl(var(--gold-dim)/.5)}.ds-etch-plate{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:2.39/1}.ds-etch-vignette{position:absolute;inset:12px;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,transparent 55%,hsl(var(--void)/.75))}.ds-etch-pool{mix-blend-mode:screen;opacity:.7;transition:opacity 600ms ease-out}.ds-etch-flare,.ds-etch-flicker{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 100%}.ds-etch-flare{transition:transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)}.ds-etch-flicker{animation:ds-etch-flicker 1.9s ease-in-out infinite alternate}.ds-etch:hover .ds-etch-flare,.ds-etch:focus-visible .ds-etch-flare{transform:scale(1.25)}.ds-etch:hover .ds-etch-pool,.ds-etch:focus-visible .ds-etch-pool{opacity:1}.ds-etch:focus-visible{outline:1px solid hsl(var(--fire));outline-offset:4px}@keyframes ds-etch-flicker{0%{transform:scale(1,1) skewX(0)}30%{transform:scale(.93,1.08) skewX(-4deg)}55%{transform:scale(1.05,.93) skewX(2deg)}80%{transform:scale(.97,1.05) skewX(-2deg)}100%{transform:scale(1.02,.97) skewX(3deg)}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-etch-flicker{animation:none}.ds-etch-flare,.ds-etch-pool{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Prologue"**

Every page opens like the opening sequence of the Peter Jackson Fellowship film: out of a black void, one fire-lit gold relic and engraved gold capitals rise into view. The ground is near-black with slow smoke drifting at two speeds over a faint warm grain; everything that matters is gold, cut into the dark and lit from the front by firelight. A single hot colour, fire orange, is held back for the Ring's inscription, the fires burning inside the project etchings, and whatever is active or in focus.

Density is cinematic, not editorial. Pages are a short sequence of scenes separated by long stretches of dark (128px to 176px between projects), each scene announced by a title card: gold Cinzel capitals, a small ring set between two gold hairlines. Prose sits in Spectral at a light weight in pale bone, the way the films set credits and captions under the titles. Each project plays as a letterboxed etching in gold line work, a scene of its own from the films (beacons, a seeing-stone, an archive, a forge), dark until it comes into view, when the gold rises and its fire catches. Skills roll like end credits. The timeline is the one object in the dark that is not gold: a map of the journey on parchment, its edges scorched into the void.

The theme is purely graphic. It lives in material, colour, type, imagery and motion, never in the words: every label, heading, nav item and button keeps its original wording. It draws only on the films, and only as homage: no logos, no real Tengwar, no film stills, no proprietary fonts. This is a single dark world with no light mode. It rejects the parchment-and-map fan page and the generic neon-on-black portfolio: parchment exists only as the About timeline's map sheet (owner, 2026-10-08), never as a page ground or panel.
keyCharacteristics: Black void ground with drifting smoke and warm grain, never a flat panel colour.
Solid fire-lit gold for display type, rules, frames and primary actions.
One reserved accent, fire orange, for the inscription, the etchings' fires and the active or focused state only.
Cinzel engraved capitals for titles and tracked credit-card labels; Spectral for all prose.
Square corners and gold hairline frames; circles belong only to Ring-derived marks.
Motion rises out of black (blur, lift, fade) on a long cinematic ease.

rules.name: The Reserved Fire Rule
rules.body: Fire orange appears only in the Ring's inscription, in the things that burn inside a project etching (flames, embers, pools of firelight), and on the active or focused state (current nav underline, focus outline, focused field underline, caret). Outside a flame it is never a fill, and it is never a heading colour, a surface decoration, or a hover state. Ember is light, not paint: it may glow or halo, but never colours text or fills a shape.

rules.name: The One Night Rule
rules.body: There is one world and it is dark. `color-scheme: dark`, no light mode, no theme toggle. New surfaces are designed on the void and nowhere else.

rules.name: The Gold Is Metal Rule
rules.body: The three golds are one material under one light: bright is the lit edge, dim is the shadow side. Reach for gold-bright only for hover, current or highlight, and gold-dim only for strokes and rules at rest.

rules.name: The Title Card Rule
rules.body: Gold Cinzel capitals with the gilded light (bevel highlight above, void cut below, ember halo) are for titles. Prose is always Spectral, never Cinzel and never gold.

rules.name: The Credit Rule
rules.body: Every small label is the credit treatment: Cinzel 600, uppercase, 0.24em tracking. Tracking may tighten to 0.14em only where a single line would otherwise wrap on narrow screens.

rules.name: The Burnished Gilt Rule
rules.body: Gold type is metal, not paint, as on the films' title cards: `--gilt` sweeps each line from a pale highlight (gilt-pale) through gold-bright and gilt-rich to a dark reflection band (gilt-deep) through the middle of the capitals, then back up to bright and down to amber (gilt-shade). `.gilded` sets it on inline text so every line gets its own sweep; headings that animate `filter` carry it on an inner span. `.gilt-label` fits the same sweep to one centred line (buttons, credit labels, nav tabs, company names), and `.gilt-initial` to the About drop cap. Filled buttons are `.gilt-plate` (pale top, rich middle, amber base, bevelled with a pale inset line above and a dark one below); outline buttons and icon roundels take `.gilt-edge`, a hairline of polished gold catching light along one diagonal.

rules.name: The Lit-Not-Lifted Rule
rules.body: Cards and panels carry no drop shadow. Depth is the gold frame, the smoke, and firelight. A new surface that needs separation gets a gold hairline or a gold rule, not elevation.

rules.name: The Square Cut Rule
rules.body: Corners are square. A round form must be read as the Ring or one of its echoes; nothing else is rounded.

dos: **Do** keep every label, heading, nav item and button in its original wording; the theme is carried by material, colour, type, imagery and motion alone.
**Do** draw only on the Peter Jackson films, and only as homage built from original material.
**Do** keep fire orange to the inscription, the etchings' fires and the active or focused state, and use ember only as light.
**Do** set every title in gilded Cinzel capitals and every small label in the 0.24em credit treatment.
**Do** separate surfaces with gold hairline frames and tapering gold rules, square-cornered.
**Do** present projects as letterboxed 2.39:1 etchings in gold line work, each a different scene from the films, lit by its own fire.
**Do** bring new content in by rising out of black on the cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) ease, and drop the motion entirely under reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** write themed copy: no franchise names, quotes, invented kickers or Middle-earth phrasing in text.
**Don't** use franchise logos, real Tengwar or Black Speech inscriptions, film stills, character art or proprietary film fonts.
**Don't** use fire orange as a fill (a flame in an etching excepted), heading colour, hover colour or decoration.
**Don't** add a light mode, a theme toggle or a light surface.
**Don't** add parchment or map textures anywhere but the About timeline's map sheet, and never neon-on-black glows.
**Don't** round corners or lift panels with drop shadows; a round form must read as the Ring.
**Don't** set prose in Cinzel or in gold.
